selection: Ten high-activity crypto tokens from the HoodExplorer registry, ordered by its displayed 24h chain volume. Tokenized stocks, ETFs, physical collectibles and RWA-category products excluded. Missing volumes are not treated as zero. The registry is not an exhaustive chain census.
poolScope: Base-token-matching Robinhood pairs quoted in ETH, canonical WETH or USDG, with positive indexed liquidity. Up to 30 returned pairs per token; this is a bounded snapshot, not every pool.
priceMethod: Token price, returns and liquidity refer to the highest-liquidity eligible observed pool for that exact contract. Registry chain volume and pool volume are separate measures and are not added together.
